verdict.rationale: Mollie's own refunds docs say refunds can be created through the API endpoint and also manually in the Mollie Web app, which covers both channels. The idempotency docs show that partial refunds exist via the API, but nothing shows full-versus-partial amount control in the dashboard. The Magento refund-manager item is a host-platform feature and earns no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of partial versus full refund amounts in the Web app, detailed Refunds API reference (amount parameters, limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds from both the dashboard and the API

citations.quote: Next to the API endpoint, you can also create refunds manually via the Mollie Web app.
executing the refund twice may lead to two separate partial refunds
